# pi-arcweld

> pi-arcweld is an auditable local workspace for the Pi coding agent: pinned upstream pi-mono source, curated Pi extensions, global system guidance, bounded MCP tooling, and a reproducible runtime built outside the upstream tree. It is not a fork of Pi.

pi-arcweld keeps local agent behavior visible without turning Pi into a private fork. The name is also written Pi Arcweld or pi arcweld. The upstream `pi-mono` source remains a pinned, unmodified Git submodule. Maintained extensions live under `extensions/`, MCP server source under `mcp-servers/`, global response guidance is appended from `system-instruction/`, and generated packages plus the runnable Pi artifact stay under the untracked `build/pi-agent/` tree.

## Curated extensions

- Plan mode (`extensions/plan-mode/`): cache-safe plan mode that appends plan state while preserving the provider prompt-cache prefix; restricts built-in write and edit to canonical plan files and blocks built-in Bash while active.
- Todos (`extensions/pi-arcweld-todos/`): always-on `update_todos` tool for tracking long-horizon work in every mode.
- MCP client (`extensions/mcp-extension/`): discovers configured Model Context Protocol servers behind a fixed, bounded two-tool model-facing surface; connection details and secrets stay outside the prompt.
- Questionnaire (`extensions/questionnaire.ts`): explicit, keyboard-operable clarification flows with single and multiple selection.
- Cache-preserving compaction (`extensions/cache-preserving-compaction/`): replays the native prompt prefix for the compaction summary request so the provider cache stays warm.
- Web search: isolated, cache-stable search tools for Claude (`claude-web-search/`), Codex (`codex-web-search.ts`), Gemini (`gemini-web-search.ts`), Grok (`grok-search.ts`), and Exa (`exa-search.ts`).
- Claude cache retention (`extensions/claude-cache-retention.ts`): one-hour prompt-cache TTL policy scoped to a local proxy provider.

## MCP servers

- Camoufox (`mcp-servers/camoufox/`): bounded Camoufox browser-automation MCP server over stdio, deployed as tested versioned releases rather than run from the checkout.

## Runtime and scripts

- `scripts/build-pi-agent.sh`: assembles, smoke-checks, and links the Pi runtime under `build/pi-agent/` without writing build state into `pi-mono/`.
- `scripts/update-pi-mono.sh`: realigns the pinned submodule onto upstream main and rebuilds; never commits or pushes.
- `scripts/check-workspace.sh`, `scripts/check-user-wiring.sh`, `scripts/check-secret-boundary.sh`: repository, user-level wiring, and credential-boundary validation.

## System instruction

- `system-instruction/APPEND_SYSTEM.md`: global append file that refines response behavior without replacing Pi's generated system prompt, tool guidance, or project context.
